purpose: Separate two sections with a decorative full-bleed band and a hard 2px rule.

constraints.maxPerPageBasis: /esg carries four, the most of any route.
constraints.RULE: The `band` value MUST equal the surface of the section IMMEDIATELY ABOVE. That is a per-instance decision, not a default.

responsive.all: the 120em band is mx-auto and at <=1280 spans the full viewport; <main>'s overflow-hidden is what stops it creating page scroll
